prompt: Summarize the following meeting notes in 2-3 sentences for the project record.
input_text: During the kickoff meeting for the Northwind Logistics project, attendees discussed the proposed three-phase rollout, which includes discovery in April and a pilot at the Hai Phong depot in early May. output_text: In the kickoff meeting for the Northwind Logistics project, participants outlined a three-phase rollout, starting with discovery in April and a pilot at the Hai Phong depot in early May.
